display_long_description:
Make room for your next great move.

LineBloom brings block puzzles into VR with a colorful board you can position comfortably in front of you. Pick up a piece, rotate it, and place it on the 8×8 grid. Complete rows and columns to clear them—and line up one clever placement to clear several at once.

• Relax in Calm mode, with no timer.
• Try Changing Pieces mode, where available pieces refresh every 10 seconds.
• Choose from three pieces and find the best fit.
• Build satisfying combos and beat your separate best score in each mode.
• Enjoy frosted-glass pieces, a redesigned board and new record celebrations.
• Learn the controls through a guided tutorial.
• Play seated or standing using Touch controllers.
• Adjust board height, distance and scale, sound, vibration and effects.
• Continue an unfinished game with locally saved progress.
• Choose English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese or Brazilian Portuguese text.

A simple idea, a clear board, and plenty of room for a clever move.
